This child is 18 months old. He has cough or difficult breathing for 3 days. He is not convulsing now and has not had convulsions. He is not lethargic or unconscious. He is able to drink or breastfeed. He does not vomit everything. He does not have diarrhoea, ear problem, or fever. I counted the breaths for one full minute and got 45 breaths per minute before giving bronchodilator. The child was calm during the counting. Chest indrawing was not present. Wheezing was present but there was no stridor when calm. I completed a bronchodilator trial. After bronchodilator, I counted breaths again for one minute and got 35 breaths per minute, with the child calm. Chest indrawing was not seen after bronchodilator. Recurrent wheeze is not present. Pulse oximeter is not available.
